name: Reverse Delay
author: Motion Audio
description: Plays what you just played backwards, a moment later: the dreamy, sucked-in repeats of an ambient guitar or a vocal throw. Two overlapping readers keep it smooth.
code:
array bL[65536]
array bR[65536]
@block
n = max(64, min(32000, floor(time * srate / 1000)))
kt = 1 - exp(-2 * pi * tone / srate)
@sample
k += 1
if (k >= n) { k = 0 }
k2 = k + n * 0.5
if (k2 >= n) { k2 -= n }
w1 = 1 - abs(2 * k / n - 1)
w2 = 1 - w1
rL = bL[w - 2 * k - 1] * w1 + bL[w - 2 * k2 - 1] * w2
rR = bR[w - 2 * k - 1] * w1 + bR[w - 2 * k2 - 1] * w2
fL += (rL - fL) * kt
fR += (rR - fR) * kt
bL[w] = inL + fL * feedback
bR[w] = inR + fR * feedback
w += 1
if (w >= 65536) { w = 0 }
outL = inL * (1 - mix) + fL * mix
outR = inR * (1 - mix) + fR * mix
